name: media-club
description: Group Watchlist & Media Club - a shared backlog of movies, shows and books for a circle of friends.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start -w server
